shared_elements: low-relief frieze in a horizontal band
human hand/clenched fist grasping an object
human figure shown in strict profile
garment/textile rendered with fine repeated incised detail
justification: Both are horizontal relief friezes with figures rendered in strict profile, fine incised surface patterning on garments/trappings, fringed hems, and a clenched fist grasping a shaft-like object, which suggests broadly comparable carving conventions. The depicted subjects differ greatly, however: A is a dense field of rosette-covered textile/trappings with only a fragment of a figure, while B is a narrative scene of a marching file of helmeted, spear-carrying men beside a tall structure with a figure atop it.
